    class SuiteShellWindow(QMainWindow):
    """Base window for every Spock suite mini-app.

    Subclasses set ``app_title``, ``nav_steps`` (center work steps), and may
    override ``build_right_dock`` / ``on_ready``.
    """

    app_title: str = "Spock Suite"
    app_subtitle: str = "Shared shell — pick a step on the left"

    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.config = load_config()
        theme_name = str(self.config.get("theme") or "light")
        if theme_name not in THEMES:
            theme_name = "light"
        self.current_theme = theme_name
        self.theme = THEMES[theme_name]
        self._status_win: Optional[StatusConsole] = None
        self._ship_status_win = None
        self._ai_helper_win: Optional[QWidget] = None
        self._step_ids: List[str] = []
        # Shared so Ship Status (Live Monitor) works in every suite wizard.
        try:
            from llama_server_manager import LlamaServerManager

            if not hasattr(self, "server_manager") and not hasattr(self, "manager"):
                self.server_manager = LlamaServerManager()
        except Exception:
            pass
        self.setWindowTitle(self.app_title)
        # Wider default so Configure Spock AI tabs 6–9 stay reachable under WSLg scaling.
        self.setGeometry(40, 40, 1600, 900)
        self._build_ui()
        self.apply_theme()
        self.on_ready()

    # --- hooks for mini-apps ---
    def nav_steps(self) -> Sequence[NavItem]:
        """Return (label, callback_or_None). None = separator."""
        return [
            ("Home", self.show_home),
            ("-----", None),
            ("AI Helper", self.open_ai_helper),
            ("About", self.open_about),
            ("Exit", self.close),
        ]

    def build_home_widget(self) -> QWidget:
        w = QWidget()
        lay = QVBoxLayout(w)
        title = QLabel(self.app_title)
        title.setStyleSheet("font-size: 22px; font-weight: bold;")
        sub = QLabel(self.app_subtitle)
        sub.setWordWrap(True)
        lay.addWidget(title)
        lay.addWidget(sub)
        lay.addStretch()
        return w

    def build_right_dock(self, layout: QVBoxLayout) -> None:
        color = SidePanel("Color Scheme", self.theme)
        color.layout.addWidget(QLabel("Theme:"))
        self.theme_combo = QComboBox()
        self.theme_combo.addItems(list(THEMES.keys()))
        self.theme_combo.setCurrentText(self.current_theme)
        self.theme_combo.currentTextChanged.connect(self.change_theme)
        color.layout.addWidget(self.theme_combo)
        layout.addWidget(color)

    def on_ready(self) -> None:
        pass

    # --- UI ---
    def _build_ui(self) -> None:
        # Three-pane splitter (nav | center | tools) — drag the handles to
        # resize panels the same way the old Spock-UIE-Wiki-KB monolith did.
        self.splitter = QSplitter(Qt.Orientation.Horizontal)
        self.splitter.setChildrenCollapsible(False)
        self.splitter.setHandleWidth(8)
        self.splitter.setOpaqueResize(True)

        left = QFrame()
        left.setObjectName("SuiteNavPane")
        left.setMinimumWidth(160)
        left_lay = QVBoxLayout(left)
        left_lay.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        left_lay.setSpacing(0)
        nav_title = QLabel("Navigation")
        nav_title.setObjectName("SuitePaneTitle")
        left_lay.addWidget(nav_title)
        scroll = QScrollArea()
        scroll.setWidgetResizable(True)
        scroll.setFrameShape(QFrame.Shape.NoFrame)
        content = QWidget()
        nav_layout = QVBoxLayout(content)
        nav_layout.setContentsMargins(10, 10, 10, 10)
        nav_layout.setSpacing(8)
        self._nav_buttons: List[ModernButton] = []
        for label, cb in self.nav_steps():
            if label.startswith("---") or cb is None:
                sep = QLabel("-----")
                sep.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
                nav_layout.addWidget(sep)
                continue
            btn = ModernButton(label, self.theme)
            btn.clicked.connect(cb)
            nav_layout.addWidget(btn)
            self._nav_buttons.append(btn)
        nav_layout.addStretch()
        scroll.setWidget(content)
        left_lay.addWidget(scroll, 1)

        self.stack = QStackedWidget()
        self._home = self.build_home_widget()
        self.stack.addWidget(self._home)

        right = QFrame()
        right.setObjectName("SuiteToolsPane")
        right.setMinimumWidth(180)
        right_lay = QVBoxLayout(right)
        right_lay.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        right_lay.setSpacing(0)
        tools_title = QLabel("Tools")
        tools_title.setObjectName("SuitePaneTitle")
        right_lay.addWidget(tools_title)
        rscroll = QScrollArea()
        rscroll.setWidgetResizable(True)
        rscroll.setFrameShape(QFrame.Shape.NoFrame)
        rcontent = QWidget()
        rlayout = QVBoxLayout(rcontent)
        rlayout.setContentsMargins(8, 8, 8, 8)
        common = SidePanel("Suite", self.theme)
        common.add_button("AI Helper", self.open_ai_helper)
        common.add_button("Ship Status", self.open_status)
        common.add_button("About", self.open_about)
        rlayout.addWidget(common)
        self.build_right_dock(rlayout)
        rlayout.addStretch()
        rscroll.setWidget(rcontent)
        right_lay.addWidget(rscroll, 1)

        self.splitter.addWidget(left)
        self.splitter.addWidget(self.stack)
        self.splitter.addWidget(right)
        self.splitter.setStretchFactor(0, 0)
        self.splitter.setStretchFactor(1, 1)
        self.splitter.setStretchFactor(2, 0)
        # Match ~1600px default so Configure Spock AI tabs 6–9 stay on-screen
        # under WSLg scaling (same usable center width as a stretched Navigation).
        self.splitter.setSizes([220, 1140, 240])
        self.setCentralWidget(self.splitter)

        # Bottom-right size grip so the whole window corners resize like before.
        status = QStatusBar()
        status.setSizeGripEnabled(True)
        self.setStatusBar(status)

    def show_home(self) -> None:
        self.stack.setCurrentWidget(self._home)

    def show_center(self, widget: QWidget) -> None:
        if self.stack.indexOf(widget) < 0:
            self.stack.addWidget(widget)
        self.stack.setCurrentWidget(widget)

    def open_ai_helper(self) -> None:
        self._ai_helper_win = open_ai_helper(self, self.theme, self.config)

    def open_status(self) -> None:
        """Open Ship Status (Live Monitor). Subclasses with a llama manager use it."""
        manager = getattr(self, "server_manager", None) or getattr(
            self, "manager", None
        )
        if manager is not None:
            from model_selector_panels import LlmStatusWindow

            if getattr(self, "_ship_status_win", None) is None:
                self._ship_status_win = LlmStatusWindow(
                    self.theme,
                    manager,
                    parent=None,
                    get_lm_config=lambda: {
                        "host": self.config.get("lm_studio_host", "localhost"),
                        "port": int(self.config.get("lm_studio_port") or 1234),
                        "context_length": int(
                            self.config.get("lm_studio_context_length") or 32768
                        ),
                    },
                    get_spock_health_context=lambda: {
                        "api_base": (
                            f"http://{(self.config.get('rag_api') or {}).get('host', '127.0.0.1')}:"
                            f"{int((self.config.get('rag_api') or {}).get('port', 8090))}"
                        ),
                        "db_path": __import__(
                            "spock_shell.paths", fromlist=["SHIP_COMPUTER_DB"]
                        ).SHIP_COMPUTER_DB,
                        "embeddings_url": (
                            (self.config.get("embedding_profile") or {}).get(
                                "embeddings_url"
                            )
                            or "http://localhost:8080/embeddings"
                        ),
                        **{
                            k: self.config.get(k)
                            for k in (
                                "llama_host",
                                "llama_port",
                                "rag_api",
                                "mcp",
                                "embedding_profile",
                            )
                        },
                    },
                    window_title="Ship Status",
                    show_lm_studio_tab=False,
                )
            else:
                self._ship_status_win.theme = self.theme
                self._ship_status_win.apply_theme()
            self._ship_status_win.show()
            self._ship_status_win.raise_()
            # Match monolith: Refresh Live Monitor as soon as the window appears.
            from PyQt6.QtCore import QTimer

            QTimer.singleShot(0, self._ship_status_win.refresh_inst_btn.click)
            return

        if self._status_win is None:
            self._status_win = StatusConsole(self.theme, self.config)
        else:
            self._status_win.config = self.config
            self._status_win.theme = self.theme
            self._status_win.apply_theme()
        self._status_win.setWindowTitle("Ship Status")
        self._status_win.show()
        self._status_win.raise_()
        from PyQt6.QtCore import QTimer

        QTimer.singleShot(0, self._status_win.refresh)

    def open_about(self) -> None:
        AboutDialog(self.theme, self.app_title, self).exec()

    def closeEvent(self, event) -> None:  # noqa: N802
        mgr = getattr(self, "server_manager", None) or getattr(self, "manager", None)
        stop_owned = getattr(mgr, "stop_owned", None)
        if callable(stop_owned):
            try:
                stop_owned()
            except Exception:
                pass
        super().closeEvent(event)

    def change_theme(self, theme_name: str) -> None:
        if theme_name not in THEMES:
            return
        self.current_theme = theme_name
        self.theme = THEMES[theme_name]
        self.config["theme"] = theme_name
        try:
            save_config(self.config)
        except Exception:
            pass
        self.apply_theme()

    def apply_theme(self) -> None:
        self.setStyleSheet(main_stylesheet(self.theme))
        for btn in self.findChildren(ModernButton):
            btn.theme = self.theme
            btn.apply_theme()
        for panel in self.findChildren(SidePanel):
            panel.theme = self.theme
            panel.apply_theme()

    def open_status(self) -> None:
    """Open Ship Status (Live Monitor). Subclasses with a llama manager use it."""
    manager = getattr(self, "server_manager", None) or getattr(
        self, "manager", None

    if manager is not None:
        from model_selector_panels import LlmStatusWindow

        if getattr(self, "_ship_status_win", None) is None:
            self._ship_status_win = LlmStatusWindow(
                self.theme,
                manager,
                parent=None,
                get_lm_config=lambda: {
                    "host": self.config.get("lm_studio_host", "localhost"),

                    "context_length": int(
                        self.config.get("lm_studio_context_length") or 32768
                    ),

                        f"http://{(self.config.get('rag_api') or {}).get('host', '127.0.0.1')}:"
                        f"{int((self.config.get('rag_api') or {}).get('port', 8090))}"
                    ),
                    "db_path": __import__(

                    "embeddings_url": (
                        (self.config.get("embedding_profile") or {}).get(

                        )

                    ),
                    **{
                        k: self.config.get(k)
                        for k in (
                            "llama_host",
                            "llama_port",
                            "rag_api",
                            "mcp",
                            "embedding_profile",
                        )
                    },
                },
                window_title="Ship Status",
                show_lm_studio_tab=False,
            )
        else:
            self._ship_status_win.theme = self.theme
            self._ship_status_win.apply_theme()
        self._ship_status_win.show()
        self._ship_status_win.raise_()
        # Match monolith: Refresh Live Monitor as soon as the window appears.
        from PyQt6.QtCore import QTimer

        QTimer.singleShot(0, self._ship_status_win.refresh_inst_btn.click)
        return

    if self._status_win is None:
        self._status_win = StatusConsole(self.theme, self.config)
    else:
        self._status_win.config = self.config
        self._status_win.theme = self.theme
        self._status_win.apply_theme()
    self._status_win.setWindowTitle("Ship Status")
    self._status_win.show()
    self._status_win.raise_()
    from PyQt6.QtCore import QTimer

    QTimer.singleShot(0, self._status_win.refresh)

    def offer_copy_ships_path_to_ask(
    parent: QWidget,
    *,
    logs: Any,
    ask: Any,
    db_path: str | Path,
    offered: Optional[MutableSet[str]] = None,
) -> bool:
    """Ask once per filter value whether to copy Ship's Logs Path → Ask AI Path.

    Returns True if the Ask AI path was updated.
    """
    path = ships_logs_path_filter(logs)
    if not path:
        return False
    get_ask = getattr(ask, "path_filter", None)
    current = str(get_ask() if callable(get_ask) else "").strip()
    if current == path:
        return False
    if offered is not None and path in offered:
        return False

    count = path_filter_match_count(db_path, path)
    if count <= 0:
        return False

    if offered is not None:
        offered.add(path)

    reply = QMessageBox.question(
        parent,
        "Copy path filter to Ask AI?",
        f"Ship's Logs Path filter is set to:\n\n{path}\n\n"
        f"{count} document(s) match in ship_computer.db.\n\n"
        "Copy this filter to Ask AI Path?",
        QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes | QMessageBox.StandardButton.No,
        QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes,
    )
    if reply != QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes:
        return False
    setter = getattr(ask, "set_path_filter", None)
    if callable(setter):
        setter(path)
        return True
    path_edit = getattr(ask, "path_edit", None)
    if path_edit is not None and hasattr(path_edit, "setText"):
        path_edit.setText(path)
        return True
    return False

    def path_filter_match_count(db_path: str | Path, path_filter: str) -> int:
    """How many documents match this path filter (extension unrestricted)."""
    raw = (path_filter or "").strip()
    if not raw:
        return 0
    try:
        from deep_dive import build_documents_filter_clause

        clause = build_documents_filter_clause(raw, "*", exclude_generated=False)
    except Exception:
        return 0
    if not clause:
        return 0
    db = Path(db_path)
    if not db.is_file():
        return 0
    try:
        conn = sqlite3.connect(str(db), timeout=5)
        try:
            row = conn.execute(
                f"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM documents WHERE {clause}"
            ).fetchone()
            return int(row[0] or 0) if row else 0
        finally:
            conn.close()
    except sqlite3.Error:
        return 0

    def ships_logs_path_filter(logs: Any) -> str:
    """Current Documents-tab Path: text from Ship's Logs, or empty."""
    getter = getattr(logs, "documents_path_filter", None)
    if callable(getter):
        return str(getter() or "").strip()
    browser = None
    if hasattr(logs, "browser") and callable(logs.browser):
        browser = logs.browser("documents")
    if browser is None:
        return ""
    filt = getattr(browser, "filter_input", None)
    if filt is None:
        return ""
    return str(filt.text() or "").strip()

    def build_brave_search_panel(theme: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None) -> QWidget:
    """Center panel with Google Search + Gemini (QWebEngineView when available)."""
    del theme  # HTML is fixed light landing page
    wrap = QWidget()
    lay = QVBoxLayout(wrap)
    lay.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
    try:
        from PyQt6.QtWebEngineWidgets import QWebEngineView

        view = QWebEngineView()
        view.setHtml(GOOGLE_SEARCH_HTML)
        lay.addWidget(view)
        wrap._web_view = view  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
    except Exception as e:
        err = QLabel(
            f"Google Search needs Qt WebEngine.\n{e}\n\n"
            "Windows (DLL load / procedure not found):\n"
            "  Close all Spock windows, then either re-run Phase B\n"
            "  or: .venv\\Scripts\\python.exe -m pip install "
            "\"PyQt6>=6.6,<6.12\" \"PyQt6-WebEngine>=6.6,<6.12\"\n"
            "  (PyQt6 6.12+ breaks WebEngine until Riverbank ships a match.)\n\n"
            "Ubuntu/WSL:\n"
            "  sudo apt install -y libnspr4 libnss3\n"
            "  .venv/bin/pip install \"PyQt6-WebEngine>=6.6,<6.12\"\n\n"
            "Or open https://www.google.com/ / https://gemini.google.com/ in a browser."
        )
        err.setWordWrap(True)
        lay.addWidget(err)
    return wrap

    def make_llm_client(cfg: dict) -> Any:
    """Build a chat client for the provider named in cfg['ask_ai_provider']."""
    apply_provider_config(cfg)
    preferred = cfg.get("ask_ai_provider") or "llama-server"
    client = LLMClient(
        prefer_lm_studio=(preferred == "LM Studio"),
        preferred_provider=preferred,
        auto_detect=True,
    )
    if preferred == "OpenAI-compatible" and cfg.get("openai_compat_model"):
        client.model = cfg["openai_compat_model"]
    elif preferred == "LM Studio" and cfg.get("lm_studio_model"):
        client.model = cfg["lm_studio_model"]
    elif preferred == "Ollama" and cfg.get("ollama_model"):
        client.model = cfg["ollama_model"]
    elif preferred == "llama-server":
        name = str(cfg.get("chat_model_name") or "").strip()
        path = str(cfg.get("chat_model_path") or "").strip()
        if not name and path:
            name = os.path.basename(path)
        LLMClient._llama_model_name = name
        client.model = client.refresh_llama_model()
    return client

    Immediate wait-cursor + progress feedback for long Qt actions.

Always clear the full override-cursor stack on exit — a single restoreOverrideCursor() leaves the spinner stuck on Windows when dialogs stacked extra overrides.

    class BusySession:
    """One in-progress busy scope (progress UI + wait cursor)."""

    def __init__(self, parent: Optional[QWidget], message: str, *, show_dialog: bool):
        self.parent = parent
        self.message = message
        self.show_dialog = show_dialog
        self.t0 = time.monotonic()
        self._win: Optional[QWidget] = None
        self._label: Optional[QLabel] = None
        self._bar: Optional[QProgressBar] = None

    def start(self) -> None:
        clear_override_cursors()
        QApplication.setOverrideCursor(Qt.CursorShape.WaitCursor)
        if self.show_dialog and self.parent is not None:
            self._win = QWidget(self.parent, Qt.WindowType.Dialog)
            self._win.setWindowTitle(self.message.split("…")[0].strip() or "Working")
            self._win.setWindowModality(Qt.WindowModality.ApplicationModal)
            self._win.setMinimumWidth(380)
            lay = QVBoxLayout(self._win)
            self._label = QLabel(f"{self.message}\nElapsed: 0s")
            self._label.setWordWrap(True)
            lay.addWidget(self._label)
            self._bar = QProgressBar()
            self._bar.setRange(0, 0)
            self._bar.setTextVisible(False)
            lay.addWidget(self._bar)
            self._win.show()
            # Center over parent
            try:
                geo = self.parent.frameGeometry()
                self._win.move(
                    geo.center().x() - self._win.width() // 2,
                    geo.center().y() - self._win.height() // 2,
                )
            except Exception:
                pass
        self.pulse()

    def pulse(self, status: Optional[str] = None) -> None:
        """Update elapsed text and let Qt paint (call during long work)."""
        if status:
            self.message = status
        secs = max(0, int(time.monotonic() - self.t0))
        if self._label is not None:
            self._label.setText(f"{self.message}\nElapsed: {secs}s")
            self._label.repaint()
        if self._bar is not None:
            self._bar.repaint()
        if self._win is not None:
            self._win.repaint()
        QApplication.processEvents(
            QEventLoop.ProcessEventsFlag.ExcludeUserInputEvents
        )

    def stop(self) -> None:
        if self._win is not None:
            self._win.hide()
            self._win.close()
            self._win.deleteLater()
            self._win = None
            self._label = None
            self._bar = None
        clear_override_cursors()
        if self.parent is not None:
            try:
                self.parent.unsetCursor()
            except Exception:
                pass
        QApplication.processEvents()

    @contextmanager
def busy_scope(
    parent: Optional[QWidget] = None,
    message: str = "Working…",
    *,
    show_dialog: bool = True,
) -> Iterator[BusySession]:
    """Wait cursor + optional progress window with elapsed seconds.

    Call ``heartbeat()`` (or ``session.pulse()``) inside long work so the
    elapsed timer advances; a plain ``QTimer`` will not fire while blocked.
    """
    session = BusySession(parent, message, show_dialog=show_dialog)
    _active.append(session)
    try:
        session.start()
        yield session
    finally:
        if _active and _active[-1] is session:
            _active.pop()
        elif session in _active:
            _active.remove(session)
        session.stop()

    def clear_override_cursors() -> None:
    """Pop every application override cursor (safe if already clear)."""
    app = QApplication.instance()
    if app is None:
        return
    while app.overrideCursor() is not None:
        app.restoreOverrideCursor()

def pause_busy_for_dialog() -> Iterator[None]:
    """Drop wait cursor while a QMessageBox is shown; restore afterward."""
    clear_override_cursors()
    QApplication.processEvents()
    try:
        yield
    finally:
        if _active:
            QApplication.setOverrideCursor(Qt.CursorShape.WaitCursor)
            _active[-1].pulse()

    def heal_paths_if_needed(*, force: bool = False) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Remap Spock_Console absolute paths after Linux↔Windows (or root) moves."""
    global _PATH_HEAL_DONE, _LAST_PATH_HEAL
    ensure_root_on_path()
    import _warpcore_path

    _warpcore_path.ensure()
    if _PATH_HEAL_DONE and not force:
        return _LAST_PATH_HEAL or {"ok": True, "skipped": True}
    from WarpCore.path_relocate import heal_relocated_paths

    report = heal_relocated_paths(SHIP_COMPUTER_DB, root=ROOT, by="suite")
    _PATH_HEAL_DONE = True
    _LAST_PATH_HEAL = report
    return report

        on_rag_start: Optional[Callable[[], None]] = None,
        on_rag_stop: Optional[Callable[[], None]] = None,
        on_profile_applied: Optional[Callable[[dict], None]] = None,
        parent=None,
    ):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.theme = theme
        self.config = config
        self._save_config = save_config
        self.db_path = db_path
        self.mcp_host = mcp_host
        # Only a host that actually owns a RagApiServer can start/stop it. Without
        # these the embedding tab just explains where the server lives.
        self._on_rag_start = on_rag_start
        self._on_rag_stop = on_rag_stop
        self._on_profile_applied = on_profile_applied
        self.mcp_panel = None
        self.webui_panel = None

        outer = QVBoxLayout(self)
        outer.addWidget(self._build_header())

        self.tabs = QTabWidget()
        self.tabs.setUsesScrollButtons(True)
        self.tabs.setDocumentMode(False)
        try:
            from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt

            self.tabs.tabBar().setElideMode(Qt.TextElideMode.ElideNone)
            self.tabs.tabBar().setExpanding(False)
        except Exception:
            pass
        self.setMinimumWidth(1100)
        self.connectors = {}
        for number, cls in enumerate(
            (LmStudioTab, OllamaTab, LlamaCppTab, OpenAiCompatTab), start=1
        ):
            tab = cls(config)
            tab.saved.connect(self._on_connector_saved)
            self.connectors[cls.provider_name] = tab
            label = {
                "LM Studio": "Connect to LM Studio",
                "Ollama": "Connect to Ollama",
                "llama-server": "Connect to llamaccp",
                "OpenAI-compatible": "Connect OpenAI-compatible",
            }[cls.provider_name]
            self.tabs.addTab(tab, f"{number}  {label}")
        self.tabs.addTab(self._build_embedding_tab(), "5  Embedding / RAG")
        self.tabs.addTab(self._build_mcp_tab(), "6  MCP")
        self.tabs.addTab(self._build_webui_tab(), "7  llama.cpp WebUI")
        self.llama_gui_embed = LlamaGuiCommandTab(
            self.config, role="embedding", db_path=self.db_path
        )
        self.llama_gui_chat = LlamaGuiCommandTab(
            self.config, role="chat", db_path=self.db_path
        )
        self.tabs.addTab(self.llama_gui_embed, "8  LLama GUI Embed")
        self.tabs.addTab(self.llama_gui_chat, "9  LLama GUI Chat")
        self.tabs.currentChanged.connect(self._on_config_tab_changed)
        outer.addWidget(self.tabs, 1)

        footer = QHBoxLayout()
        self.profile_btn = QPushButton("Save to Profile…")
        self.profile_btn.setToolTip(
            "Store these settings as a named Spock profile in ship_computer.db"
        )
        self.profile_btn.clicked.connect(self.save_profile_requested.emit)
        footer.addWidget(self.profile_btn)
        manage_btn = QPushButton("Manage profiles…")
        manage_btn.setToolTip("Review and delete saved profiles (obsolete GGUFs, duplicates)")
        manage_btn.clicked.connect(self._manage_profiles)
        footer.addWidget(manage_btn)
        footer.addStretch()
        outer.addLayout(footer)

        self.refresh_active_provider()

    def _manage_profiles(self) -> None:
        from spock_shell.profiles import open_manage_profiles_dialog

        open_manage_profiles_dialog(self)

    # --- header ---
    def _build_header(self) -> QWidget:
        box = QGroupBox("Active provider")
        lay = QHBoxLayout(box)
        self.active_lbl = QLabel("")
        self.active_lbl.setWordWrap(True)
        lay.addWidget(self.active_lbl, 1)
        probe = QPushButton("Re-detect")
        probe.setToolTip("Ask the client which backend it can actually reach now")
        probe.clicked.connect(self.probe_active_provider)
        lay.addWidget(probe)
        return box

    def refresh_active_provider(self) -> None:
        name = self.config.get("ask_ai_provider") or "llama-server"
        self.active_lbl.setText(
            f"Ask AI and Deep Dive are pinned to <b>{name}</b>. "
            "Saving on a connector tab re-pins it."
        )

    def collect_all(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Snapshot every tab — used when saving or naming a Spock profile."""
        out: Dict[str, Any] = {}
        for tab in self.connectors.values():
            try:
                out.update(tab.collect())
            except Exception:
                pass
        panel = getattr(self, "embedding_panel", None)
        if panel is not None:
            try:
                out["embedding_profile"] = panel._collect_profile()
            except Exception:
                pass
            try:
                out["rag_api"] = panel.collect_rag_api()
            except Exception:
                pass
        from mcp_panel import merge_mcp_settings

        mcp_cfg = merge_mcp_settings(self.config.get("mcp"))
        for name in ("mcp_panel", "webui_panel"):
            sibling = getattr(self, name, None)
            collect = getattr(sibling, "collect_settings", None)
            if callable(collect):
                try:
                    mcp_cfg.update(collect())
                except Exception:
                    pass
        out["mcp"] = mcp_cfg
        launch = dict(self.config.get("launch") or {})
        if getattr(self, "llama_gui_embed", None) is not None:
            launch["llama_gui_embed_command"] = self.llama_gui_embed.editor.toPlainText()
        if getattr(self, "llama_gui_chat", None) is not None:
            launch["llama_gui_chat_command"] = self.llama_gui_chat.editor.toPlainText()
        out["launch"] = launch
        provider = str(self.config.get("ask_ai_provider") or "").strip()
        if provider:
            out["ask_ai_provider"] = provider
        return out

    def _on_config_tab_changed(self, _index: int) -> None:
        w = self.tabs.currentWidget()
        refresh = getattr(w, "refresh_status", None)
        if callable(refresh):
            QTimer.singleShot(0, refresh)
        if w is self.mcp_panel and self.mcp_host is not None:
            QTimer.singleShot(400, self.mcp_host.ensure_http_adapter_async)

    def probe_active_provider(self) -> None:
        try:
            client = make_llm_client(self.config)
        except Exception as e:
            self.active_lbl.setText(f"Provider probe failed: {e}")
            return
        pinned = self.config.get("ask_ai_provider") or "llama-server"
        if not client.is_available:
            self.active_lbl.setText(
                f"Pinned to <b>{pinned}</b> but nothing is reachable. "
                f"{client.last_error or 'Start the backend, then Re-detect.'}"
            )
            return
        reached = client.active_provider
        detail = f"reached <b>{reached}</b> at {client.active_url}"
        if reached != pinned:
            detail += f" (pinned provider {pinned} is not answering)"
        self.active_lbl.setText(f"Pinned to <b>{pinned}</b>, {detail}")

    # --- tabs ---
    def _build_embedding_tab(self) -> QWidget:
        from model_selector_core import merge_embedding_profile
        from model_selector_panels import EmbeddingProfilePanel

        panel = EmbeddingProfilePanel(
            self.theme,
            profile=merge_embedding_profile(self.config.get("embedding_profile")),
            rag_api=self.config.get("rag_api") or {},
            db_path=self.db_path,
        )
        panel.profile_applied.connect(self._profile_applied)
        panel.rag_api_start.connect(
            lambda: self._rag_lifecycle("START RAG API", self._on_rag_start)
        )
        panel.rag_api_stop.connect(
            lambda: self._rag_lifecycle("STOP RAG API", self._on_rag_stop)
        )
        self.embedding_panel = panel
        return panel

    def _mcp_settings(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        from mcp_panel import merge_mcp_settings

        mcp_cfg = merge_mcp_settings(self.config.get("mcp"))
        # Legacy flat key wins when present so old configs keep their port.
        if self.config.get("mcp_http_port"):
            try:
                mcp_cfg["http_port"] = int(self.config["mcp_http_port"])
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                pass
        return mcp_cfg

    def _unavailable(self, message: str) -> QWidget:
        placeholder = QWidget()
        lay = QVBoxLayout(placeholder)
        msg = QLabel(message)
        msg.setWordWrap(True)
        lay.addWidget(msg)
        lay.addStretch()
        return placeholder

    def _build_mcp_tab(self) -> QWidget:
        from mcp_panel import McpControlPanel

        if self.mcp_host is None:
            return self._unavailable(
                "MCP adapter control is unavailable in this window."
            )

        mcp_cfg = self._mcp_settings()
        panel = McpControlPanel(
            self.theme,
            script_path=self.mcp_host.script_path(),
            python_exe=self.mcp_host.python_exe(),
            start_adapter=self.mcp_host.start_adapter,
            stop_adapter=self.mcp_host.stop_adapter,
            find_adapter=self.mcp_host.find_adapter,
            adapter_status=self.mcp_host.adapter_status_text,
            adapter_pids=self.mcp_host.running_pids,
            health_context=self.mcp_host.health_context,
            ensure_http_adapter=self.mcp_host.ensure_http_adapter_async,
            settings=mcp_cfg,
        )
        panel.settings_changed.connect(self.mcp_host.on_settings_changed)
        self.mcp_host.panel = panel
        self.mcp_panel = panel
        return panel

    def _build_webui_tab(self) -> QWidget:
        from mcp_panel import LlamaWebUiPanel

        if self.mcp_host is None:
            return self._unavailable(
                "llama.cpp WebUI control is unavailable in this window."
            )
        panel = LlamaWebUiPanel(
            self.theme,
            settings=self._mcp_settings(),
            ensure_http_adapter=self.mcp_host.ensure_http_adapter_async,
        )
        panel.settings_changed.connect(self.mcp_host.on_settings_changed)
        self.webui_panel = panel
        return panel

    # --- persistence ---
    def _persist(self) -> None:
        try:
            self._save_config()
        except Exception as e:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Configure Spock AI", f"Could not save:\n{e}")

    def _on_connector_saved(self, values: Dict[str, Any], provider: str) -> None:
        self.config.update(values)
        self.config["ask_ai_provider"] = provider
        self._persist()
        try:
            apply_provider_config(self.config)
        except Exception as e:
            QMessageBox.warning(
                self, "Configure Spock AI", f"Settings saved but not applied:\n{e}"
            )
        self.refresh_active_provider()
        self.provider_changed.emit(provider)

    def _profile_applied(self, profile: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        if self._on_profile_applied is not None:
            self._on_profile_applied(profile)
            return
        self.config["embedding_profile"] = profile
        self.config["rag_api"] = self.embedding_panel.collect_rag_api()
        self._persist()

    def _rag_lifecycle(
        self, action: str, handler: Optional[Callable[[], None]]
    ) -> None:
        if handler is None:
            QMessageBox.information(
                self,
                action,
                "This window cannot run the RAG API server.\n\n"
                "Open Spock Navigation Station → Configure and use the same "
                "buttons there. Host, port and API key saved here are what it "
                "will bind to.",
            )
            return
        try:
            handler()
        except Exception as e:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, action, f"{action} failed:\n{e}")

    class LlamaGuiCommandTab(QWidget):
    """Paste a Llama GUI Quick Launch View Command and save it for one role."""

    def __init__(self, config: Dict[str, Any], role: str, db_path: str, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.config = config
        self.role = "embedding" if role in ("embedding", "embed") else "chat"
        self.db_path = db_path
        from WarpCore.service_endpoints import (
            DEFAULT_CHAT_PORT,
            DEFAULT_EMBED_PORT,
            resolve_ports,
        )

        ports = resolve_ports(config)
        self.expected_port = int(
            ports["embed"] if self.role == "embedding" else ports["chat"]
            or (DEFAULT_EMBED_PORT if self.role == "embedding" else DEFAULT_CHAT_PORT)
        )
        lay = QVBoxLayout(self)
        note = QLabel(
            "In Llama GUI, open Quick Launch, choose View Command, copy the line, "
            "then Paste. Save stores it for the Launch LLama GUI button."
        )
        note.setWordWrap(True)
        lay.addWidget(note)
        self.editor = QPlainTextEdit()
        self.editor.setPlaceholderText("llama-server.exe -m ... --port ...")
        self.editor.setLineWrapMode(QPlainTextEdit.LineWrapMode.WidgetWidth)
        launch = config.get("launch") if isinstance(config.get("launch"), dict) else {}
        key = (
            "llama_gui_embed_command"
            if self.role == "embedding"
            else "llama_gui_chat_command"
        )
        self.editor.setPlainText(str(launch.get(key) or ""))
        lay.addWidget(self.editor, 1)
        self.summary = QLabel("")
        self.summary.setWordWrap(True)
        lay.addWidget(self.summary)
        row = QHBoxLayout()
        paste = QPushButton("Paste")
        paste.setToolTip("Replace the box with the current clipboard text")
        paste.clicked.connect(self._paste)
        save = QPushButton("Save")
        save.clicked.connect(self._save)
        clear = QPushButton("Clear")
        clear.clicked.connect(self._clear)
        row.addWidget(paste)
        row.addWidget(save)
        row.addWidget(clear)
        row.addStretch()
        lay.addLayout(row)
        self._refresh_summary()

    def _paste(self) -> None:
        clip = QApplication.clipboard()
        text = clip.text() if clip is not None else ""
        self.editor.setPlainText(text or "")
        self._refresh_summary()

    def _clear(self) -> None:
        self.editor.setPlainText("")
        self._save()

    def _save(self) -> None:
        from spock_shell.llama_gui_command import save_saved_text

        text = self.editor.toPlainText()
        try:
            save_saved_text(self.db_path, self.role, text)
        except Exception as exc:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "LLama GUI command", f"Could not save:\n{exc}")
            return
        launch = dict(self.config.get("launch") or {})
        key = (
            "llama_gui_embed_command"
            if self.role == "embedding"
            else "llama_gui_chat_command"
        )
        launch[key] = text
        self.config["launch"] = launch
        self._refresh_summary()

    def _refresh_summary(self) -> None:
        from spock_shell.llama_gui_command import (
            command_warnings,
            flag_value,
            parse_llama_gui_command,
            parse_port,
        )

        text = self.editor.toPlainText().strip()
        if not text:
            self.summary.setText("No command saved yet.")
            return
        try:
            argv = parse_llama_gui_command(text)
        except ValueError as exc:
            self.summary.setText(str(exc))
            return
        model = flag_value(argv, ("-m", "--model"))
        port = parse_port(argv, self.expected_port)
        lines = [f"Model: {model}", f"Port: {port}"]
        lines.extend(command_warnings(argv, self.role, self.expected_port))
        self.summary.setText("\n".join(lines))

    def probe_called_llm(timeout: int = 300) -> ProbeResult:
    """Ask the saved LLM client to reply PING. Failures are returned, not raised.

    Same path as::

        from _start_rag_api import load_cfg
        from spock_rag_adapter.bridge_host import make_llm_client
        llm = make_llm_client(load_cfg())
        llm.ask_with_context('Reply with PING', 'Context: PING')
    """
    try:
        from _start_rag_api import load_cfg
        from spock_rag_adapter.bridge_host import make_llm_client

        llm = make_llm_client(load_cfg())
    except Exception as e:
        return False, f"Could not build LLM client: {type(e).__name__}: {e}"
    try:
        provider = llm.active_provider
        model = llm.model
        available = bool(llm.is_available)
    except Exception as e:
        return False, f"LLM status read failed: {type(e).__name__}: {e}"
    header = f"Provider: {provider} | Model: {model} | Available: {available}"
    if not available:
        detail = getattr(llm, "last_error", "") or "No reachable provider."
        return False, f"{header}\n{detail}"
    try:
        response = llm.ask_with_context(
            "Reply with PING", "Context: PING", timeout=timeout
        )
    except Exception as e:
        return False, f"{header}\nLLM call failed: {type(e).__name__}: {e}"
    text = str(response or "").strip()
    if not text:
        detail = getattr(llm, "last_error", "") or "Empty response."
        return False, f"{header}\n{detail}"
    if text.lower().startswith("could not reach"):
        return False, f"{header}\nResponse: {_one_line(text, 500)}"
    if "ping" not in text.lower():
        return False, (
            f"{header}\nResponse did not include PING: {_one_line(text, 500)}"
        )
    return True, f"{header}\nResponse: {_one_line(text, 500)}"

    def probe_rag_health(base_url: str, timeout: float = 8) -> ProbeResult:
    """Check OpenAI-compatible RAG ``GET /health``."""
    url = base_url.rstrip("/") + "/health"
    data, err = _fetch_json(url, timeout)
    if err or data is None:
        return False, f"Health {url} — {err}"
    status = str(data.get("status") or "").strip()
    summary = (
        f"status={status or '(missing)'} | "
        f"llm_provider={data.get('llm_provider') or 'None'} | "
        f"model={data.get('model') or '(none)'} | "
        f"embeddings={data.get('embeddings_url') or '(none)'} | "
        f"web_ui={data.get('web_ui') or '(none)'}"
    )
    if status.lower() != "ok":
        return False, f"Health {url} — {summary}"
    return True, f"Health OK — {summary}"

    def probe_rag_props(base_url: str, timeout: float = 8) -> ProbeResult:
    """Check OpenAI-compatible RAG ``GET /props``."""
    url = base_url.rstrip("/") + "/props"
    data, err = _fetch_json(url, timeout)
    if err or data is None:
        return False, f"Properties {url} — {err}"
    settings = data.get("default_generation_settings")
    if not isinstance(settings, dict):
        return False, f"Properties {url} — missing default_generation_settings"
    model = str(settings.get("model") or "").strip()
    if not model:
        return False, f"Properties {url} — default_generation_settings.model is empty"
    summary = (
        f"model={model} | slots={data.get('total_slots')} | "
        f"model_path={data.get('model_path') or '(none)'}"
    )
    note = str(data.get("spock_note") or "").strip()
    if note:
        summary += f" | {_one_line(note, 160)}"
    return True, f"Properties OK — {summary}"

    def rag_api_base(config: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]) -> str:
    """RAG API origin. Defaults match ``Invoke-RestMethod http://127.0.0.1:8090``."""
    rag = (config or {}).get("rag_api") if isinstance(config, dict) else None
    rag = rag if isinstance(rag, dict) else {}
    host = str(rag.get("host") or "127.0.0.1").strip() or "127.0.0.1"
    try:
        port = int(rag.get("port") or 8090)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        port = 8090
    if port < 1 or port > 65535:
        port = 8090
    return f"http://{host}:{port}"

    def guarded_hybrid_search(hybrid_search_fn):
    """Wrap WarpCore.hybrid_search so a wrong :8080 GGUF fails instead of mixing spaces."""

    def _wrapped(*args, **kwargs):
        url = str(kwargs.get("embeddings_url") or "")
        assert_live_matches_corpus(url)
        return hybrid_search_fn(*args, **kwargs)

    return _wrapped

    def live_vs_corpus(
    embeddings_url: str = "",
    *,
    profile_model_path: str = "",
    profile_model_id: str = "",
    db_path: str = "",
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Compare live :8080, optional profile GGUF, and kb_embedding_corpus.

    Hard mismatch is live server vs KB corpus (what actually embeds vs stored
    vectors). Profile path is advisory: a directory-only ``model_path`` is
    ignored unless ``model_id`` / a joined file yields a real GGUF identity.
    """
    corpus = read_corpus(db_path)
    url = embeddings_url or (corpus or {}).get("embeddings_url") or (
        "http://localhost:8080/embeddings"
    )
    live = probe_live_model(url)
    corpus_path = str((corpus or {}).get("model_path") or "")
    live_path = str(live.get("model_path") or "")
    profile_path = resolve_gguf_identity(profile_model_path, profile_model_id)
    out: Dict[str, Any] = {
        "corpus": corpus,
        "live": live,
        "profile_model_path": profile_path or str(profile_model_path or ""),
        "ok": True,
        "mismatch": False,
        "profile_mismatch": False,
        "port_occupied_wrong_model": False,
        "message": "",
    }
    if not corpus_path:
        return out
    # Blocking: live GGUF must match the wiki-scan corpus when the server is up.
    if live.get("reachable") and live_path and not models_match(live_path, corpus_path):
        out["ok"] = False
        out["mismatch"] = True
        out["port_occupied_wrong_model"] = True
    # Advisory: profile GGUF (if resolvable) differs from corpus/live.
    if profile_path and corpus_path and not models_match(profile_path, corpus_path):
        out["profile_mismatch"] = True
    if profile_path and live_path and live.get("reachable") and not models_match(
        profile_path, live_path
    ):
        out["profile_mismatch"] = True
    if out["mismatch"]:
        out["message"] = format_mismatch(
            corpus_path=corpus_path,
            live_path=live_path if live.get("reachable") else "",
            profile_path=profile_path,
            live_reachable=bool(live.get("reachable")),
        )
    elif out["profile_mismatch"]:
        out["message"] = (
            format_mismatch(
                corpus_path=corpus_path,
                live_path=live_path if live.get("reachable") else "",
                profile_path=profile_path,
                live_reachable=bool(live.get("reachable")),
            )
            + "\n\nNote: live server matches the KB; only the saved profile "
            "path/id looks stale. Wiki Scan can proceed."
        )
    return out

    def models_match(a: str, b: str) -> bool:
    """True if two GGUF identities are the same path or the same basename."""
    fa, fb = fold_path(a), fold_path(b)
    if not fa or not fb:
        return False
    if fa == fb:
        return True
    return fold_path(model_basename(a)) == fold_path(model_basename(b))

    def record_from_live_server(

) -> Tuple[bool, str, Optional[Dict[str, Any]]]:
    """Probe :8080 and persist kb_embedding_corpus. False if server/model unknown."""
    live = probe_live_model(embeddings_url)
    if not live.get("reachable"):
        return False, (
            "Embedding server is not answering on "
            f"{live.get('host')}:{live.get('port')}. "
            "Launch the embedding GGUF on :8080 before Wiki Scan."
        ), live
    if not live.get("model_path"):
        return False, (
            "Embedding server is up but did not report a GGUF path "
            "(/props or /v1/models). Will not scan under an unknown model."
        ), live
    row = write_corpus(
        model_path=str(live["model_path"]),
        embeddings_url=embeddings_url,
        embeddings_dim=embeddings_dim,
        model_id=model_id,
        db_path=db_path,
    )
    return True, f"Recording embeddings from {row.get('model_name') or row.get('model_path')}", row

    def resolve_gguf_identity(path: str = "", model_id: str = "") -> str:
    """Best GGUF identity from a path and/or model id.

    Embedding profiles sometimes store a *directory* in ``model_path`` and the
    filename in ``model_id``. A bare directory must not be compared as a GGUF
    (basename would be ``models`` and false-mismatch KB/live).
    """
    p = str(path or "").strip()
    mid = str(model_id or "").strip()
    if p and is_gguf_path(p):
        return p
    if p and os.path.isdir(p) and mid and is_gguf_path(mid):
        joined = os.path.join(p, model_basename(mid))
        if os.path.isfile(joined):
            return joined
        return mid
    if mid and is_gguf_path(mid):
        return mid
    if p and os.path.isfile(p):
        return p
    return ""

    def path_filter_excludes_spock(path_filter: str) -> bool:
    """True when a non-empty Path filter likely hides Spock app sources."""
    raw = (path_filter or "").strip()
    if not raw:
        return False
    parts = [p.strip() for p in re.split(r"[;|]", raw) if p.strip()]
    if not parts:
        return False
    for part in parts:
        low = _norm(part).replace("\\", "/").lower()
        if any(m in low for m in _SPOCK_ROOT_MARKERS):
            return False
        # Bare fragment that still matches Spock tree names
        if "spock" in low and "llama.cpp" not in low:
            return False
    return True

    def tip_launch_fit(
    *,
    model_path: str,
    n_ctx: int,
    vram_gb: float,
    role: str = "chat",
    sibling_size_gb: float = 0.0,
) -> Optional[str]:
    """Warn before Launch when weights+KV look too large for the selected GPU."""
    role = (role or "chat").lower()
    if role.startswith("embed"):
        return None
    path = Path(model_path or "")
    if not path.is_file():
        return None
    try:
        weights_gb = path.stat().st_size / (1024**3)
    except OSError:
        return None
    vram = float(vram_gb or 0.0)
    if vram <= 0:
        return None
    try:
        from spock_scanner_core import recommend_n_ctx
    except Exception:
        return None

    info = recommend_n_ctx(
        vram,
        role="chat",
        model_size_gb=weights_gb,
        sibling_size_gb=float(sibling_size_gb or 0.0),
    )
    recommended = int(info.get("n_ctx") or 0)
    headroom = info.get("headroom_gb")
    tips: List[str] = []

    # Weights alone exceed usable card (rough — ignores partial offload).
    if weights_gb * 1.05 > vram * 0.92:
        tips.append(
            f"GGUF ~{weights_gb:.1f}GB is tight for ~{vram:.0f}GB VRAM — "
            "expect CPU offload and slow/timeout Deep Dive answers."
        )
    if recommended and int(n_ctx) > recommended * 1.5:
        tips.append(
            f"Context (-c) {int(n_ctx)} is well above Suggest Context ({recommended}) "
            f"for this card/model — KV may force CPU layers."
        )
    if headroom is not None and float(headroom) <= 0 and weights_gb > 0:
        tips.append(
            "Little/no VRAM headroom left for KV after weights — "
            "lower -c via Suggest Context or use a smaller quant."
        )
    if not tips:
        return None
    return "Fit warning: " + " ".join(tips)

    def tip_pack_saturation(timing: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]) -> Optional[str]:
    """Deep Dive packed to the token window — suggest -c or narrower Path."""
    t = timing or {}
    mode = str(t.get("mode") or "")
    if mode != "deep_dive":
        return None
    try:
        pct = float(t.get("budget_used_pct") or 0.0)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        pct = 0.0
    if pct < 95.0:
        return None
    used = t.get("used_docs") if t.get("used_docs") is not None else t.get("docs_used")
    n_ctx = t.get("n_ctx")
    budget = t.get("budget")
    bits = [
        f"Tip: Deep Dive filled ~{pct:.0f}% of the pack budget"
    ]
    if used is not None:
        bits.append(f"({used} docs used)")
    if n_ctx:
        bits.append(f"at live n_ctx={n_ctx}")
    elif budget:
        bits.append(f"(budget {budget})")
    bits.append(
        "— raise Launch Context (-c) if VRAM allows (Suggest Context), "
        "or narrow Path so fewer large files compete for the window."
    )
    return " ".join(bits)

    def create_or_confirm_host_recipe(
    parent: Optional[QWidget],
    db_path: str,
    *,
    reason: str,
    created_by: str,
    confirm_title: str = "Create host recipe",
    confirm_body: str = "",
) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """Probe → primary GPU prompt (multi-GPU) → Yes/No → create or update.

    Used by Bringup, Maintenance reset rebuild, and Navigation Station so the
    same question cannot be skipped by a silent ``ensure_recipe``.
    """
    import json

    from PyQt6.QtWidgets import QMessageBox

    from WarpCore import host_recipe as hr

    live = hr.probe_hardware()
    current = hr.get_current_recipe(db_path)
    need_create = current is None
    need_confirm = hr.needs_primary_ai_gpu_prompt(
        live, (current or {}).get("recipe") if current else None
    )
    if not need_create and not need_confirm:
        return current

    built = propose_recipe_with_primary_prompt(
        parent, hardware=live, force_primary_prompt=need_confirm
    )
    if built is None:
        return None
    live, proposed = built
    preview = json.dumps(
        {
            "gpu_policy": proposed.get("gpu_policy"),
            "embed_gpu_index": proposed.get("embed_gpu_index"),
            "chat_gpu_index": proposed.get("chat_gpu_index"),
            "tensor_split": proposed.get("tensor_split"),
            "embed_n_ctx": proposed.get("embed_n_ctx"),
            "chat_n_ctx": proposed.get("chat_n_ctx"),
            "gpu_summary": proposed.get("gpu_summary"),
            "host_ram_gb": proposed.get("host_ram_gb"),
        },
        indent=2,
    )
    body = confirm_body.strip() or (
        "No host recipe yet. Create Launch defaults from this machine?"
        if need_create
        else "Confirm the primary AI GPU and save an updated host recipe?"
    )
    reply = QMessageBox.question(
        parent,
        confirm_title,
        f"{body}\n\n{preview}\n\n"
        "(You can Update later in Engineering Maintenance → Recipe.)",
        QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes | QMessageBox.StandardButton.No,
        QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes,
    )
    if reply != QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes:
        return None
    if need_create:
        return hr.create_recipe(
            db_path,
            hardware=live,
            recipe=proposed,
            reason=reason,
            created_by=created_by,
        )
    return hr.update_recipe(
        db_path,
        reason=reason,
        hardware=live,
        recipe=proposed,
        created_by=created_by,
    )

    def prompt_primary_ai_gpu(
    parent: Optional[QWidget],
    hardware: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
) -> Optional[int]:
    """Ask which GPU runs embed + chat when the host has more than one.

    Returns the chosen nvidia-smi index, the sole GPU index when there is only
    one card, or ``None`` if the user cancels the multi-GPU dialog.
    """
    from WarpCore import host_recipe as hr

    rows = hr.gpu_choice_rows(hardware)
    if not rows:
        return 0
    if len(rows) == 1:
        return int(rows[0]["index"]) if rows[0].get("index") is not None else 0

    default = hr.default_primary_ai_gpu_index(hardware)
    # parent=None + ApplicationModal: avoids dialogs stuck behind SuiteShell.
    dlg = QDialog(None)
    dlg.setWindowTitle("Primary AI GPU")
    dlg.setWindowModality(Qt.WindowModality.ApplicationModal)
    dlg.setMinimumWidth(560)
    layout = QVBoxLayout(dlg)
    layout.addWidget(
        QLabel(
            "This machine has multiple GPUs.\n"
            "Which GPU should run embedding and chat LLM servers?\n\n"
            "Pick the compute card if another GPU is used for video/display\n"
            "(for example Quadro P2200 for monitors, RTX 6000 for AI)."
        )
    )
    group = QButtonGroup(dlg)
    radios: list = []
    for r in rows:
        # GPU 0 is valid — never use ``index or 0``.
        idx = int(r["index"]) if r.get("index") is not None else 0
        btn = QRadioButton(str(r.get("label") or f"GPU {idx}"))
        if idx == default:
            btn.setChecked(True)
        group.addButton(btn)
        layout.addWidget(btn)
        radios.append((btn, idx))
    if not any(b.isChecked() for b, _ in radios) and radios:
        radios[0][0].setChecked(True)

    buttons = QDialogButtonBox(
        QDialogButtonBox.StandardButton.Ok | QDialogButtonBox.StandardButton.Cancel
    )
    buttons.accepted.connect(dlg.accept)
    buttons.rejected.connect(dlg.reject)
    layout.addWidget(buttons)
    dlg.show()
    dlg.raise_()
    dlg.activateWindow()
    if dlg.exec() != QDialog.DialogCode.Accepted:
        return None
    for btn, idx in radios:
        if btn.isChecked():
            return idx
    return default

    def propose_recipe_with_primary_prompt(
    parent: Optional[QWidget],
    *,
    hardware: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    force_primary_prompt: bool = False,
) -> Optional[Tuple[Dict[str, Any], Dict[str, Any]]]:
    """Live probe → optional primary-GPU prompt → recipe.

    Returns ``(hardware, recipe)`` or ``None`` if the user cancels a multi-GPU
    primary selection.
    """
    from WarpCore import host_recipe as hr

    hw = hardware if isinstance(hardware, dict) else hr.probe_hardware()
    proposed = hr.propose_recipe(hw)
    ask = force_primary_prompt or hr.needs_primary_ai_gpu_prompt(hw, proposed)
    if ask and hr.multi_gpu_host(hw):
        idx = prompt_primary_ai_gpu(parent, hw)
        if idx is None:
            return None
        proposed = hr.apply_primary_ai_gpu(proposed, idx, hardware=hw)
    elif not hr.multi_gpu_host(hw):
        # Single-GPU / CPU: nothing to choose; mark confirmed so later probes
        # do not keep re-asking if a second card appears mid-session.
        proposed = dict(proposed)
        proposed["primary_ai_gpu_confirmed"] = True
    return hw, proposed

    def find_port_listener(port: int) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """The process listening on ``port``, if one can be seen.

    A llama-server whose command line names the port counts even when the
    socket table is hidden. Any other listener is returned as foreign so the
    Launch button will not kill it.
    """
    try:
        import psutil
    except ImportError:
        return None
    port_i = int(port)
    llama_pid: Optional[int] = None
    try:
        processes = list(psutil.process_iter(["pid", "name", "cmdline"]))
    except Exception:
        processes = []
    for proc in processes:
        info = proc.info if hasattr(proc, "info") else {}
        name = str(info.get("name") or "")
        if "llama-server" not in name.lower():
            continue
        cmd = list(info.get("cmdline") or [])
        if _cmdline_port(cmd, port_i):
            try:
                llama_pid = int(info.get("pid") or proc.pid)
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                continue
            break
    listen_pid: Optional[int] = None
    listen_name = ""
    try:
        connections = psutil.net_connections(kind="inet")
    except Exception:
        connections = []
    for conn in connections:
        status = str(getattr(conn, "status", "") or "")
        if status != getattr(psutil, "CONN_LISTEN", "LISTEN") and status != "LISTEN":
            continue
        laddr = getattr(conn, "laddr", None)
        if laddr is None or int(getattr(laddr, "port", -1) or -1) != port_i:
            continue
        pid = getattr(conn, "pid", None)
        name = ""
        if pid:
            try:
                name = str(psutil.Process(int(pid)).name() or "")
            except Exception:
                name = ""
        listen_pid = int(pid) if pid else None
        listen_name = name
        if "llama-server" in name.lower():
            return {
                "pid": listen_pid,
                "name": name or "llama-server",
                "is_llama_server": True,
            }
        return {
            "pid": listen_pid,
            "name": name,
            "is_llama_server": False,
        }
    if llama_pid is not None:
        return {"pid": llama_pid, "name": "llama-server", "is_llama_server": True}
    return None

    def flag_value(argv: List[str], names: tuple) -> str:
    """Value of the first matching flag. ``--flag=value`` and ``--flag value``."""
    wanted = {name.lower() for name in names}
    i = 0
    while i < len(argv):
        token = argv[i]
        low = token.lower()
        for name in wanted:
            if low == name:
                if i + 1 < len(argv):
                    return argv[i + 1]
                return ""
            prefix = name + "="
            if low.startswith(prefix):
                return token.split("=", 1)[1]
        i += 1
    return ""

    def restart_llama_server(port: int, wait_s: float = 60.0) -> str:
    """Stop llama-server on this port and start the same command again.

    A NaN embedding poisons that GPU process. Later requests stay null until
    the process is replaced. A server on any other port is left running.
    """
    import subprocess
    import time
    import urllib.request

    listener = find_port_listener(port)
    if not listener or not listener.get("is_llama_server") or not listener.get("pid"):
        return f"Could not restart: port {int(port)} has no llama-server."
    pid = int(listener["pid"])
    try:
        import psutil

        proc = psutil.Process(pid)
        argv = [str(part) for part in (proc.cmdline() or [])]
        try:
            env = proc.environ()
        except Exception:
            env = os.environ.copy()
        try:
            cwd = proc.cwd()
        except Exception:
            cwd = None
    except Exception as exc:
        return f"Could not restart llama-server on port {int(port)}: {exc}"
    if not argv:
        return f"Could not restart: llama-server on port {int(port)} has no command line."
    _terminate_pid_tree(pid)
    log_dir = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))), "logs")
    os.makedirs(log_dir, exist_ok=True)
    stamp = time.strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")
    log_path = os.path.join(log_dir, f"llama-server-port{int(port)}-{stamp}.log")
    flags = 0
    if os.name == "nt":
        flags = getattr(subprocess, "CREATE_NO_WINDOW", 0) | getattr(
            subprocess, "CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP", 0
        )
    try:
        with open(log_path, "a", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as log_fp:
            subprocess.Popen(
                argv,
                cwd=cwd or None,
                env=env,
                stdout=log_fp,
                stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                creationflags=flags,
            )
    except Exception as exc:
        return f"Could not restart llama-server on port {int(port)}: {exc}"
    health = f"http://127.0.0.1:{int(port)}/health"
    deadline = time.time() + float(wait_s)
    while time.time() < deadline:
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(health, timeout=2) as resp:
                if resp.status == 200:
                    return (
                        f"Restarted llama-server on port {int(port)} "
                        f"after a null embedding. Log: {log_path}"
                    )
        except Exception:
            time.sleep(0.5)
    return (
        f"Could not restart: llama-server on port {int(port)} did not become healthy. "
        f"Log: {log_path}"
    )

    def split_llama_gui_command(text: str) -> List[str]:
    """Split a View Command line the way Llama GUI quoteArg would rejoin it."""
    tokens: List[str] = []
    buf: List[str] = []
    in_quote = False
    i = 0
    source = text or ""
    while i < len(source):
        ch = source[i]
        if in_quote:
            if ch == "\\" and i + 1 < len(source) and source[i + 1] == '"':
                buf.append('"')
                i += 2
                continue
            if ch == '"':
                in_quote = False
                i += 1
                continue
            buf.append(ch)
            i += 1
            continue
        if ch == '"':
            in_quote = True
            i += 1
            continue
        if ch in " \t\r\n":
            if buf:
                tokens.append("".join(buf))
                buf = []
            i += 1
            continue
        buf.append(ch)
        i += 1
    if in_quote:
        raise ValueError("The Llama GUI command has an unclosed quote.")
    if buf:
        tokens.append("".join(buf))
    return tokens

    def best_fit_ids(
    *,
    role: str = "chat",
    limit: int = 6,
    timeout_s: float = 30.0,
) -> List[str]:
    """Top model names / GGUF repos from the dashboard, else empty (caller falls back)."""
    overrides = {"limit": max(1, int(limit))}
    try:
        from llmfit_session_criteria import filters_as_query

        filters = filters_as_query(role=role, overrides=overrides)
    except Exception:
        filters = dict(overrides)
    payload = query_models(role=role, filters=filters, timeout_s=timeout_s)
    if not payload:
        return []
    models = payload.get("models")
    if not isinstance(models, list):
        return []
    out: List[str] = []
    seen = set()
    for row in models:
        if not isinstance(row, dict):
            continue
        candidates: List[str] = []
        name = str(row.get("name") or "").strip()
        if name:
            candidates.append(name)
        for src in row.get("gguf_sources") or []:
            if isinstance(src, dict):
                repo = str(src.get("repo") or "").strip()
                if repo:
                    candidates.append(repo)
        for cand in candidates:
            key = cand.lower()
            if key in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(key)
            out.append(cand)
            break
        if len(out) >= max(1, int(limit)):
            break
    return out

    def dashboard_available(*, timeout_s: float = 1.5) -> bool:
    """True when ``GET /health`` succeeds on the dashboard base URL."""
    try:
        import urllib.error
        import urllib.request

        req = urllib.request.Request(
            dashboard_base() + "/health",
            headers={"Accept": "application/json"},
            method="GET",
        )
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout_s) as resp:
            if resp.status != 200:
                return False
            raw = resp.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
        data = json.loads(raw) if raw else {}
        return isinstance(data, dict) and str(data.get("status") or "").lower() == "ok"
    except Exception:
        return False

    def dashboard_rows_as_hub(
    *,
    role: str = "chat",
    limit: int = 6,
    timeout_s: float = 30.0,
) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """Map dashboard model rows into Hub-ish dicts for ``top_role_fits``."""
    overrides = {"limit": max(1, int(limit))}
    try:
        from llmfit_session_criteria import filters_as_query

        filters = filters_as_query(role=role, overrides=overrides)
    except Exception:
        filters = dict(overrides)
    payload = query_models(role=role, filters=filters, timeout_s=timeout_s)
    if not payload:
        return []
    kind = "embedding" if role in ("embed", "embedding") else "chat"
    rows: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    for row in payload.get("models") or []:
        if not isinstance(row, dict):
            continue
        mid = ""
        for src in row.get("gguf_sources") or []:
            if isinstance(src, dict) and src.get("repo"):
                mid = str(src["repo"]).strip()
                break
        if not mid:
            mid = str(row.get("name") or "").strip()
        if not mid:
            continue
        try:
            size_b = float(row.get("params_b") or 0.0)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            size_b = 0.0
        hub = {
            "id": mid,
            "size_b": size_b,
            "kind": kind,
            "native_ctx": int(row.get("context_length") or row.get("usable_context") or 8192),
            "fit_level": row.get("fit_level") or row.get("fit_label"),
            "estimated_tps": row.get("estimated_tps"),
            "score": int(round(float(row.get("score") or 0.0))),
            "source": "llmfit-dashboard",
            "llmfit_best_quant": row.get("best_quant"),
        }
        rows.append(hub)
    return rows

    out = dict(row)

    if hit.get("fit_level"):

    if hit.get("run_mode"):
        out["llmfit_run_mode"] = hit["run_mode"]
    if hit.get("best_quant"):
        out.setdefault("llmfit_best_quant", hit["best_quant"])
    return out

    def hardware_fingerprint(system_payload: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None) -> str:
    """Stable key for caching fit estimates against this machine."""
    payload = system_payload if system_payload is not None else system_info_cached()
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        return "unknown"
    sysinfo = payload.get("system") if isinstance(payload.get("system"), dict) else payload
    if not isinstance(sysinfo, dict):
        return "unknown"
    gpu = str(sysinfo.get("gpu_name") or "")
    try:
        vram = float(sysinfo.get("gpu_vram_gb") or 0.0)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        vram = 0.0
    try:
        ram = float(sysinfo.get("total_ram_gb") or 0.0)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        ram = 0.0
    backend = str(sysinfo.get("backend") or "")
    return f"{backend}|{gpu}|{vram:.1f}|{ram:.0f}"

    def lookup_fit_estimate(
    model_id: str,
    *,
    index: Optional[Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]] = None,
) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """Match an HF / catalog id to a cached llmfit fit row."""
    key = _normalize_model_key(model_id)
    if not key:
        return None
    idx = index if index is not None else fit_estimate_index()
    if key in idx:
        return idx[key]
    # Substring / containment fallback for publisher-prefixed ids
    best: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
    best_len = 0
    for k, entry in idx.items():
        if len(k) < 6:
            continue
        if k in key or key in k:
            if len(k) > best_len:
                best = entry
                best_len = len(k)
    return best

    def model_hint_from_path(model_path: str) -> str:
    """Best-effort selector string for ``llmfit plan`` from a GGUF path."""
    stem = Path(model_path).stem
    # Strip common quant suffixes so llmfit can fuzzy-match the catalog name.
    stem = re.sub(
        r"[.\-_](Q\d+_K(_[MSXL])?|Q\d+_0|IQ\d+_XXS|f16|fp16|bf16)$",
        "",
        stem,
        flags=re.IGNORECASE,
    )
    return stem.replace("_", "-")

    def query_models(
    *,
    role: str = "chat",
    filters: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    timeout_s: float = 30.0,
) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """``GET /api/v1/models`` with session criteria (or explicit ``filters``).

    Returns the JSON envelope, or ``None`` when the dashboard is offline /
    returns non-JSON. Never raises for connectivity failures.
    """
    try:
        import urllib.error
        import urllib.parse
        import urllib.request

        from llmfit_session_criteria import filters_as_query

        params = filters if isinstance(filters, dict) else filters_as_query(role=role)
        query = urllib.parse.urlencode(
            {k: v for k, v in params.items() if v is not None and v != ""},
            doseq=True,
        )
        url = dashboard_base() + "/api/v1/models"
        if query:
            url = url + "?" + query
        req = urllib.request.Request(
            url, headers={"Accept": "application/json"}, method="GET"
        )
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout_s) as resp:
            raw = resp.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
        data = json.loads(raw) if raw else None
        return data if isinstance(data, dict) else None
    except Exception:
        return None

    def resolve_ngl(
    model_path: str,
    *,
    n_ctx: int = 8192,
    quant: Optional[str] = None,
    current_ngl: str = "-1",
    use_llmfit: bool = True,
) -> Tuple[str, str]:
    """Resolve launch ``-ngl``.

    When ``current_ngl`` is not the sentinel ``-1`` / ``auto``, it wins.
    Otherwise consult llmfit plan for the GGUF stem.
    """
    cur = (current_ngl or "-1").strip()
    if cur.lower() == "auto":
        cur = "-1"
    if cur != "-1":
        return cur, "explicit -ngl"

    if not use_llmfit or not available():
        return "-1", "llmfit unavailable"

    hint = model_hint_from_path(model_path)
    raw = _cached_plan(hint, int(n_ctx), quant or "")
    plan_data = json.loads(raw) if raw else None
    return suggest_ngl_from_payloads(plan_data=plan_data)

    def suggest_ngl_from_payloads(
    *,
    plan_data: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    model_row: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
) -> Tuple[str, str]:
    """Derive a llama-server ``-ngl`` value from llmfit JSON.

    Returns ``(ngl, reason)``. Falls back to ``-1`` (full offload) when the
    payloads do not justify a safer partial/CPU setting.
    """
    if model_row:
        from_verify = parse_ngl_from_verify_command(str(model_row.get("verify_command") or ""))
        run_mode = str(model_row.get("run_mode") or model_row.get("run_mode_label") or "").lower()
        avail = model_row.get("memory_available_gb")
        req = model_row.get("memory_required_gb")
        fit_level = str(model_row.get("fit_level") or model_row.get("fit_label") or "").lower()

        if "cpu" in run_mode and "gpu" not in run_mode and "offload" not in run_mode:
            return "0", "llmfit run_mode=CPU"

        try:
            avail_f = float(avail) if avail is not None else None
            req_f = float(req) if req is not None else None
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            avail_f = req_f = None

        if avail_f is not None and req_f is not None and req_f > 0 and avail_f < req_f * 0.92:
            # Oversubscribed: map free fraction onto 1..99 layers (llmfit verify uses 99).
            frac = max(0.05, min(0.95, (avail_f / req_f) * 0.85))
            ngl = str(max(1, min(99, int(round(99 * frac)))))
            return ngl, f"llmfit VRAM tight ({avail_f:.1f}/{req_f:.1f} GiB) → partial -ngl {ngl}"

        if from_verify and fit_level in ("perfect", "good", ""):
            return from_verify, f"llmfit verify_command -ngl {from_verify}"

        if fit_level in ("perfect", "good") or "gpu" in run_mode:
            return "-1", f"llmfit fit_level={fit_level or 'gpu'}"

    if plan_data:
        current = plan_data.get("current") if isinstance(plan_data.get("current"), dict) else {}
        run_mode = str(current.get("run_mode") or "").lower()
        fit_level = str(current.get("fit_level") or "").lower()
        if run_mode in ("cpu", "cpu_only") or fit_level == "impossible":
            return "0", f"llmfit plan run_mode={run_mode or fit_level}"
        if "offload" in run_mode:
            return "24", "llmfit plan suggests CPU+GPU offload (conservative -ngl 24)"
        if fit_level in ("perfect", "good") or run_mode in ("gpu",):
            return "-1", f"llmfit plan fit_level={fit_level or run_mode}"

    return "-1", "llmfit default full offload"

    def system_info_cached(*, refresh: bool = False) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """Session-cached ``llmfit --json system``.

    The raw call is a subprocess with a 45 s timeout, and it sits behind every
    Hub query through ``hardware_fingerprint``. Hardware does not change
    mid-session, so probe once and hand back a copy.
    """
    if refresh:
        _system_info_json.cache_clear()
    raw = _system_info_json()
    if not raw:
        return None
    try:
        data = json.loads(raw)
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        return None
    return data if isinstance(data, dict) else None

    def system_to_gpu_list(system_payload: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """Convert ``llmfit --json system`` into scanner-style GPU dicts."""
    if not isinstance(system_payload, dict):
        return []
    sysinfo = system_payload.get("system") if isinstance(system_payload.get("system"), dict) else system_payload
    if not isinstance(sysinfo, dict):
        return []
    out: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    gpus = sysinfo.get("gpus")
    if isinstance(gpus, list) and gpus:
        for g in gpus:
            if not isinstance(g, dict):
                continue
            name = str(g.get("name") or "").strip()
            if not name:
                continue
            # Skip useless display-only iGPUs when llmfit marks tiny/null VRAM
            # and a discrete GPU is also present (filter later if needed).
            try:
                vram_gb = float(g.get("vram_gb") if g.get("vram_gb") is not None else 0.0)
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                vram_gb = 0.0
            backend = str(g.get("backend") or "").upper()
            vendor = "nvidia" if "CUDA" in backend or "NVIDIA" in name.upper() else "other"
            if "APPLE" in backend or "METAL" in backend:
                vendor = "apple"
            if "ROCM" in backend or "AMD" in name.upper():
                vendor = "amd"
            if "INTEL" in name.upper() or "ARC" in name.upper():
                vendor = "intel"
            out.append(
                {
                    "vendor": vendor,
                    "name": name,
                    "vram_mb": int(round(vram_gb * 1024)),
                    "source": "llmfit",
                    "backend": backend or None,
                    "unified_memory": bool(g.get("unified_memory")),
                }
            )
    elif sysinfo.get("has_gpu") and sysinfo.get("gpu_name"):
        try:
            vram_gb = float(sysinfo.get("gpu_vram_gb") or 0.0)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            vram_gb = 0.0
        name = str(sysinfo.get("gpu_name") or "GPU")
        backend = str(sysinfo.get("backend") or "").upper()
        vendor = "nvidia" if "CUDA" in backend else "other"
        out.append(
            {
                "vendor": vendor,
                "name": name,
                "vram_mb": int(round(vram_gb * 1024)),
                "source": "llmfit",
                "backend": backend or None,
                "unified_memory": bool(sysinfo.get("unified_memory")),
            }
        )
    # Drop zero-VRAM stubs when any positive-VRAM device exists
    if any(g.get("vram_mb", 0) > 0 for g in out):
        out = [g for g in out if int(g.get("vram_mb") or 0) > 256]
    return out

    def build_markdown_home(
    theme: Dict[str, str],
    md_path: Union[str, Path],
    *,
    fallback_title: str = "Home",
    fallback_subtitle: str = "",
) -> QWidget:
    """QWidget with a scrollable markdown view of ``md_path`` (HELPER or abs)."""
    path = Path(md_path)
    if not path.is_absolute():
        path = helper_md_path(str(md_path))

    wrap = QWidget()
    lay = QVBoxLayout(wrap)
    lay.setContentsMargins(12, 12, 12, 12)

    browser = QTextBrowser()
    browser.setOpenExternalLinks(True)
    browser.setStyleSheet(
        f"""
        QTextBrowser {{
            background: {theme.get('panel_bg', theme.get('bg', '#1e1e1e'))};
            color: {theme.get('fg', '#e0e0e0')};
            border: 1px solid {theme.get('border', '#444')};
            border-radius: 6px;
            padding: 12px;
            font-size: 13px;
        }}
        """
    )

    if path.is_file():
        try:
            text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        except OSError as e:
            text = f"# Missing HELPER doc\n\nCould not read `{path}`: {e}"
        browser.setMarkdown(text)
        lay.addWidget(browser)
    else:
        title = QLabel(fallback_title)
        title.setStyleSheet("font-size: 22px; font-weight: bold;")
        sub = QLabel(
            fallback_subtitle
            or f"Create `{HELPER_DIR}/{path.name}` for this module’s Home page."
        )
        sub.setWordWrap(True)
        lay.addWidget(title)
        lay.addWidget(sub)
        lay.addStretch()

    wrap._md_path = path  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
    wrap._browser = browser if path.is_file() else None  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
    return wrap
